issues.title: Single 40M-row UPDATE
issues.explanation: One UPDATE over 40M rows rewrites every row inside one long transaction: row locks, table bloat and replication lag while the app is live.
issues.fix: Ship the column now; backfill in batches (e.g. 10k rows per statement) from a separate job.

issues.title: Index build blocks writes
issues.explanation: Plain CREATE INDEX holds a lock that blocks inserts and updates on invoices until the build finishes.
issues.fix: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, in its own migration outside a transaction.
